answer: One concrete defense is the drilled-core registry. Each seat must bore a fresh sample from a numbered basalt block on the outer reef and lodge its banding scan with the shared kernel ledger before the epoch closes. Tide layers make every core unique, so no sample can be recut or replayed. A thousand cloned wallets share one block, one core and one ledger entry, and the kernel folds them into a single seat. Faking depth means hiring a certified driller and boat hours per block, so attacker cost grows linearly and soon outruns the flat per-seat emission.
